messages.body:
Dear Allotments Office,

Our household (H-306) is giving up Brook Meadow plot BM-30. Please take this email as written notice that we surrender the tenancy with effect from today, 16 October 2026. Farouk is still on the waiting list and would love a Brook Meadow plot of his own one day.

Leila Benbow

Morning,

Please run the 2027 lettings round on Monday 2 November against the vacancies on the log and anything that has fallen vacant since. Offers go out by message on the day, and new tenants join the plot holders' news list. The tenancy year starts on 1 January 2027.

Parks manager
